races.paceDynamic: Son Of Wind stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the rail, likely getting an uncontested lead with only An Laochmor, Sovereign Banter, Snowballs and Rattletheonionbag showing prominent tendencies. This creates a moderate pace scenario where Son Of Wind can control the tempo without early pressure, while the majority field (Oxford Circus, Winemaker, Jered Maddox, Rough Diamond, Hot To Foxtrot, Cooee Call) are all hold-up performers who will need the race to develop. With one leader controlling the tempo and a packed field of closers, this race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind gets an easy lead without early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the closers to make up ground, allowing Son Of Wind to maintain his advantage or the tracking prominent horses to strike late. The hold-up horses get caught in traffic with insufficient pace collapse to aid their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If An Laochmor or Sovereign Banter track Son Of Wind closely and apply pressure from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The early leader weakens under sustained pressure, creating the perfect scenario for the tracking prominent horses to inherit the lead. The hold-up horses still face the same traffic issues with moderate pace throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses engage in early skirmishes and create a genuinely strong pace
scenarios.body: Son Of Wind and the prominent trackers weaken significantly in the final furlong, allowing the best of the hold-up horses to produce late rallies. This requires clear runs and genuine pace collapse to be effective.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind goes too fast early trying to shake off persistent prominent pressure
scenarios.body: The entire front group stops dramatically, creating a sprint finish where positioning and traffic luck become crucial. The longest-priced hold-up horses with tactical speed could emerge from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Wind's early fractions will determine the entire race outcome - if he goes too slow the closers are in trouble, too fast and he'll be vulnerable
Traffic congestion in the final 2f will be severe with seven hold-up performers needing room - watch for horses getting blocked
An Laochmor's positioning turning for home is crucial as the best-positioned prominent runner to capitalise if the leader weakens
Jered Maddox and Cooee Call both show patterns of fading in finishes, making them unreliable even if the pace sets up right
The 7lb claiming allowances for Jimmy Dalton and Sadhbh Tormey could prove decisive in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Real Encounter will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, likely getting an uncontested lead through steady fractions. With most rivals holding up tactics (Aughlish, Meriden, Allsortz, Atallah), the pace will be comfortable early before quickening from the 2f pole. The three unraced newcomers (Beach Barbie, Coasting, Hinder) add uncertainty but their connections suggest they may not be immediate pace factors. This race shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can exploit the soft early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Real Encounter Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Real Encounter gets the easy lead he's set up for
scenarios.body: The proven front runner exploits comfortable fractions before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. His previous Standard going form and returning Shane Foley booking suggests connections expect improvement.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Quality Surfaces
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unraced trio shows above-average ability
scenarios.body: Beach Barbie or Coasting could have the class edge over this modest maiden field despite tactical disadvantage. Their higher official ratings and quality connections suggest potential.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely allowing closers time
scenarios.body: Allsortz gets the perfect setup to repeat his recent second-place finish with the race falling apart late. His recent Standard going form gives him an edge over the other hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hinder Shows Natural Speed
scenarios.trigger: If the G M Lyons newcomer breaks fast and races prominently
scenarios.body: Hinder could surprise by not conforming to hold-up tactics and instead pressing Real Encounter early. The Colin Keane booking and trainer's decent recent record suggest confidence.

watchPoints.text: Real Encounter's early position is crucial - if he breaks slowly or gets headed early, his chance evaporates
Watch Beach Barbie's market moves and early positioning as the most intriguing unraced runner with highest rating

Allsortz needs a steady pace to be effective, watch for him to be niggled along if Real Encounter goes too slow
The three newcomers' stall positions and early pace tactics will reveal their trainers' expectations

races.paceDynamic: Straight Back Up and Private Larry will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a genuine gallop over this 7f trip. Royal County Glory may track prominently from her low draw, while the majority of the field prefers to settle and come with late runs. With two pace-setters who both carry fade-in-finish warnings, the early gallop should be honest enough to set up the race for the hold-up horses. This pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can position off the pace and deliver sustained finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners duel early and fade as expected
scenarios.body: The honest early pace will perfectly set up the patient hold-up horses to deliver their trademark late charges. Horses like Imperial Fighter, Macadam's Rock, and Methgal can use their proven finishing ability to sweep past the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Private Larry or Straight Back Up gets uncontested early fractions
scenarios.body: A softer early pace allows one of the leaders to maintain enough energy for the finish despite their fade tendencies. The reduced pressure early could see them hold off the late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Royal County Glory can secure the ideal stalking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: The 3yo can use her prominent style to track the early pace before striking in the straight with less ground to make up than the hold-up horses. Her recent consistent form gives her the edge over similar styles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners show their fade tendencies earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A complete pace collapse would favour any horse that can quicken from mid-division, potentially catching the hold-up horses too far back. This chaotic scenario opens the door for horses with tactical speed.

races.paceDynamic: Jawhary represents the sole confirmed front-runner in this 12-runner handicap and faces no immediate pace pressure from the start. With Expert Analysis the only other prominent runner but carrying fade-in-finish warnings, Jawhary should dictate terms through comfortable fractions. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses including Desert Friend, Slowdownbarney, and Sarmiento Power who will need the pace to develop. This race shape strongly favours patient hold-up horses who can benefit from Jawhary's sustainable gallop and finish strongly in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Jawhary leads unchallenged through comfortable fractions with no early pace pressure
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get ideal racing room and can unleash late runs down the straight. Desert Friend and Slowdownbarney are perfectly positioned to capitalise on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Jawhary Dominates Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Jawhary maintains strong gallop throughout and his recent winning form transfers to this longer trip
scenarios.body: The front-runner proves too classy for the closers who face an impossible task reeling him in. Expert Analysis may provide brief company but fades as expected.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse Creates Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Jawhary stops unexpectedly or Expert Analysis forces unsustainable early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical muddle with no clear pace anchor, suiting horses with versatile styles. Sarmiento Power and Fine Print can adapt better than pure hold-up types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses move simultaneously entering the straight creating traffic problems
scenarios.body: The first movers gain crucial advantages while others are trapped behind weakening horses. Celtic Druid and Al What may benefit from forcing earlier moves.

races.paceDynamic: With A Pretty Penny now a non-runner, Ramair becomes the sole confirmed front-runner in this small field of seven. The 3-year-old will likely get an uncontested lead or at worst have minimal early pressure, setting honest fractions over this 1m2½f trip. Behind him, five hold-up horses (Keepsgettingbetter, Elm Creek, Cameclose, Musashi, Sea Of Dubka) will be waiting to pounce in the straight. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up performers who can benefit from the likely steady pace and strong finishing kick required.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ramair Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Ramair secures an uncontested lead and sets moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms and potentially steal a march on the hold-up brigade who may leave their runs too late. Ramair's recent placings show he can stay when getting an easy time of it.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and the closers time their runs perfectly
scenarios.body: The quintet of hold-up horses will have every chance to wind up from the back and the race becomes a sprint finish. Superior class will tell in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ramair Folds Late
scenarios.trigger: If Ramair sets honest fractions but his stamina gives out in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The leader's fade opens the door for the first closer to challenge, potentially catching the others napping. This suits horses with tactical speed who can quicken first.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos From Lack
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to go forward and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with hold-up horses getting in each other's way and possibly running out of room. Whoever gets the clearest run wins.
